shuffleTest.note: This tests OUTCOME randomness, not strategy skill. It demonstrates the machinery the gates use; it is not evidence that any strategy is profitable.

calibrationDemo.note: A constant 55% prior needs at least 20 games in a decile to be scored; with almost all mass in one bin this is a weak calibration test, shown to prove the method runs.
